newsitem.title: INDIA: India ONGC raises DEM 66.5 mln term loan.
newsitem.headline: India ONGC raises DEM 66.5 mln term loan.

text.p: India's Oil & Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) has raised DEM 66.5 million through a syndicated term loan facility arranged by ANZ Investment Bank, State Bank of India and Barclays de Zoette Wedd, ANZ Grindlays Bank said on Monday.
The loan has a door-to-door life of seven years and an average life of 3.75 years, the bank said in a statement.
The facility was signed on December 15. The pricing was 40 bppa (basis points per annum) over six-month FIBOR (Frankfurt Inter Bank Offered Rate).
The funds were raised to meet prepayment of an existing loan availed from Berliner Handels und Frankfurter Bank (BHF), the statement said.
